title: spec(conversions): the stored pass maps no object_extension row onto objectExtensions, so no conversion or refused-shape detector ever runs over a stored extension
body:
domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSduNGC2SZXszyrNut

Filing gate: ② an out-of-scope finding the #29366 dev reported on PR #29513 (round 2, head `fb1c5bc9`) and the seat's delta review confirmed in the tree (6585110935). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

## What happens

`applyConversionsToStoredItem` (`packages/spec/src/conversions/stored.ts`) wraps a stored row in the stack collection named by `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL[type] ?? STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS[type]` and returns the row untouched when neither names one. `object_extension` is in neither map, so a stored `object_extension` row is never wrapped as `objectExtensions: [row]`. As a result:

- no ADR-0087 conversion that walks `objectExtensions[]` replays over a stored extension row at any rehydration seam;
- no `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector can list one, so `os migrate meta --stored` reads every stored extension as already on protocol. PR #29513's entry `object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused` has to name a manual check for exactly this reason.

The dev's probe: an `object_extension` row with `fieldPatches.Industry` and a time default came back as the same reference, 0 TODOs, 0 notices; the control `object` row had its time default rewritten (1 notice).

## Done when

- First measure which stored-row type name the extension rows carry (`object_extension`, and any plural spelling the protocol read fallback finds) and whether the manifest map omits it deliberately (as it does `translations`).
- `STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS` (or the shared map, if the omission is not deliberate) maps it to `objectExtensions`, with a test that a stored extension row now gets an `objectExtensions` conversion and a control that other types are unchanged.
- Then a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector for `object-extension-field-patch-key-grammar-refused`, and that entry's `acceptanceCriteria` and changeset sentence that say `--stored` does not list such a row are corrected.

Serial: after PR #29513 (it touches that entry).

Related: #29366 / PR #29513, #19620 (`STORED_ONLY_COLLECTIONS`), #29523.
